# C17 — Vikalpa–Saṃkalpa


## #0 — A course arises within a circumstance

Vikalpa–saṃkalpa is the constructive movement through which a field of experience becomes a possible course. Vikalpa differentiates what is available into qualified alternatives; saṃkalpa gathers selected differences into an intention, resolve or workable arrangement. Each has its work within the other. An intention needs distinctions through which it can take form, and a distinction changes which intentions can be formed.

The circumstance is already active. Memory, language, concern and the available means give a possibility its present significance. Two people may bear the same name, yet the situation lets a speaker address this person rather than the other. Name, instance and circumstance are held together before every condition of that address has been separately articulated. Constructive thought draws from this field and changes it by what it brings into focus.

## #1 — Differentiate what can be proposed

The shared root `√kḷp` concerns fitting, arranging, preparing and forming. Differentiation and gathering are two directions of this formative power: a field is articulated into alternatives and selected differences are composed into a course. Vikalpa makes a possibility determinate enough to compare. This rather than that, this under one description rather than another: the alternatives receive their character through an act of qualification. The act specifies what would count as a different course. A comparison made under another circumstance can alter the alternatives themselves, as well as which of them is preferred.

The [inner instrument](C16-Antahkarana-Inner-Instrument.md) differentiates the work involved. Judgment determines; appropriation gathers a determination as mine or as belonging to this undertaking; coordination holds presentations and alternatives available together. These functions give an intention material on which to work. [Apoha](C18-Apoha.md) makes one relation within that material exact: a term's excluded contrast participates in what the term can mean. Forming a course uses such determinations and adds the question of what to do with them.

## #2 — Recollection becomes material for another possibility

A retained experience can be recalled without simply being repeated. In [Dyczkowski's account of reflection](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration.md#page-71-continuation), an affection leaves a residual trace, remembrance recalls a prior affection, and imagination selects and recomposes retained material into a new one. Retention, recollection and composition are different capacities. The difference between them is what allows the inherited field to become the material of a new formation.

Saṃkalpa gives selected possibilities a direction. Their gathering becomes an intention or commitment sufficiently settled to guide an act. What was available as an alternative is now sustained as a course. This settlement changes the situation: something can be attempted, another possibility is left aside, and the attempt can meet a consequence which was not present in the first imagining.

The [constructive process](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md) therefore includes both differentiation and recomposition. The course inherits conditions, selects among them and contributes another condition. Its return cannot be reduced to repeating the state from which it began.

## #3 — A formed course can conceal its formation

A dependable course permits continuity. It becomes [frozen conditioned will](C12-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will.md) when its alternatives and conditions can no longer affect how it is enacted. The achieved selection then presents itself as necessity. What first organised a field begins to govern which evidence about that organisation is admissible.

A generated account makes this arrest concrete. Its conclusion enters a later context, where it can be used as a conclusion drawn from a particular source. If that relation disappears, the conclusion can take the source's place. A later account now confirms an earlier paraphrase while the original text recedes. Repetition increases the appearance of support without restoring the act of comparison that would establish it. Once the earlier paraphrase sets what the next account can admit, [the course repeats its own selection as necessity](../A07-Vikalpa-Samkalpa-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will.md) and loses the source’s power to correct it.

The constructive pair remains the means of reopening it. Vikalpa differentiates the inherited account from its source and makes another reading available. Saṃkalpa gathers the recovered relation into a course which can now proceed differently. The next act can inherit a corrected source, answer or representation under a criterion that already fits the inquiry. Where the encounter exposes a failure in that criterion, the criterion itself becomes available for revision. The formation changes at the condition the comparison actually reaches, and the later judgment proceeds from that changed inheritance.

## #4 — Thought can turn upon its own determination

The [pure notion](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3.md) carries the counter-operation within thought. A śuddha-vikalpa is worked as a determinate formation which holds its own opposite and opens the conviction it would otherwise fix. Thought refines thought until the formed proposition can release its claim to enclose what it concerns. Its success lies in the recognition it makes possible, including recognition of its own limit. Nirvikalpa names awareness without constructed alternatives; a thought that opens toward this limit still has its own work to perform.

The photograph gives the relation a visible form. A landscape appears under the conditions of an aperture, frame and sensitivity. Recognising those conditions changes what can be inferred from the image without taking away what the image actually shows. Devotion to the specific frame and openness to what exceeds it belong together: the frame is a means of encounter whose particular disclosure matters.

The historical debate concerns the standing of such constructions as well as their operation. [MacCracken's discussion](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/maccracken/maccracken-2017-recognizing-recognition/maccracken-2017-recognizing-recognition.md) places Dharmakīrti's account of relations as epistemic beside realist objections to a merely contrived relation. An epistemic account and a realist account make different claims about what relation constitutes. The disagreement changes what construction can be said to constitute: an epistemic relation or a real relation. Its consequences remain active when the constructive operations are compared. [Prakāśa–vimarśa](C13-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) gives appearing and reflexive self-articulation their particular Śaiva relation.

## #5→0 — The encounter changes what can be formed next

A [prompted action-space](C44-Prompt-Thrownness.md) inherits a task, history and available means. Their arrangement conditions which alternatives can be proposed and carried forward. A returned source, refusal or consequence becomes effective through the condition it exposes: answer, source, task interpretation, representation, evaluator, permission or commission. Restoring a misquoted passage can change the interpretation and next citation while retaining a fitting criterion of fidelity. If the rule admits only the earlier paraphrase, or a permission prevents the original from reaching judgment, return has to reach that rule or its responsible authority. The criterion changes when the encounter warrants that change; reasoned retention can renew a course whose means now receive the source more faithfully. A correction that is recorded but never inherited by a later judgment leaves the return unperformed.

[Deferential intelligence](C47-Deferential-Intelligence.md) names the capacity for encounter to reach the model or criterion as well as its answer. [Name-through-Count](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD-encounter-region-name-count.md#name-through-count) restores the circumstance through which the selected account became addressable. Another person can challenge the description under which they were received; an original text can change the interpretation that has been made of it. The gathering becomes answerable to the relation it gathered.

A formed intention can then be retained, revised or relinquished for reasons the encounter supplies. Conditioning continues, but its alternatives become available again. The earlier act remains part of the history; the history now supports a course it could not previously form.
